ℹ️ Reducing Balance & Interest Accrual In a reducing balance loan, interest is calculated on the outstanding balance remaining after each monthly payment. When you pay for some months, the outstanding amount reduces, meaning less interest is added in each subsequent period. Making an extra monthly or lump-sum payment reduces the balance immediately, resulting in lower interest added and shorter loan duration.
